figure_alt: Horizontal dot-and-interval chart of the 20 largest same-day gaps in signifier Yes rates. Conservative, Trump supporter, and right-wing show the largest gaps toward higher rates among Republican Yes respondents, on the right. Anti-Trump shows the largest gap toward a higher rate among Republican No respondents, on the left. Every interval stays on its side of zero.
prompt: Report the 20 signifiers that are most diagnostic of a Republican Yes versus No. Discuss the potential meaning more than methodology.
title: The 20 signifiers most diagnostic of a Republican Yes or No
